metadata.title: Gromov hyperbolicity and uniformity
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we first exhibit an example which answers negatively to a question posed by Herron et al. in 2008. That is, there is a rectifiably connected open set in a proper geodesic metric space so that it is Gromov hyperbolic with respect to the quasihyperbolic metric, and its Gromov boundary endowed with a visual metric is naturally bilipschitz equivalent to its metric boundary, but it is not uniform. Moreover, two positive answers are given under additional hypotheses. It is shown that a metric space is uniform if and only if it is Gromov hyperbolic and the natural map between its Gromov closure and its metric completion exists and satisfies a relatively quasisymmetric condition. Both bounded and unbounded cases are in our considerations via two different uniformization theorems developed recently by Bonk et al. and the first author, respectively. Finally, we characterize uniform metric spaces with uniformly perfect boundaries in terms of Gromov hyperbolicity and Teichmüller's displacement property.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 拟双曲Gromov边界与一致性的刻画
analysis.workSummary: 定理1.2以紧测地梳状树Y和X=Y\{o,a}给反例，拟双曲空间(X,k)为0-双曲树，两个Gromov边界点与度量边界自然双Lipschitz对应，但X不一致。定理1.3对局部紧、可求长连通、不完备X刻画有界一致性，需局部定量拟凸、diam X≤C dist(w,∂X)、(X,k)双曲且以w为基点BoS-visual，以及整个Gromov闭包至完备化自然映射的相对拟对称性。
techniques: 以长度度量赋予梳状树并比较齿长与边界距离
拟双曲度量k与Ibragimov双曲化度量h的粗拟等距比较
BoS/BuSc视觉性质与相对拟对称映射
有界共形密度和无界Busemann一致化
analysis.breakthrough: 定理1.4给无界版本，保留局部拟凸，以某无穷远点的roughly starlike及Busemann视觉度量下去掉该点的闭包相对拟对称性替代有界条件。定理1.5/1.6在边界一致完美时以边界幂拟对称及位移性质刻画一致性，有界情形另需diam X≤ν diam∂X。所有结果给参数相互依赖的定量控制。
analysis.limitations: 相对拟对称控制涉及闭包中以边界点为首点或另两点均在边界的三元组，不能省略成单独边界拟对称。位移性质考察从(X,h)到(X,k)的粗拟等距自映射且边界为恒等，对所有控制常数要求k(x,f(x))统一有界。无界边界一致完美性在球面化的一点扩充上理解。仅核对主定理、反例与路线，未复核全部一致化估计。

analysis.priorityReason: 直接涉及Gromov双曲性、一致化和边界几何，优先核对反例与等价条件。
